item.title: How to reverse an array in JavaScript
item.description: Reversing the order of array elements is useful for displaying data in descending order, implementing undo functionality, or creating reverse chronological lists in JavaScript applications. As the creator of CoreUI, I’ve implemented array reversal in components like activity feeds, breadcrumb navigation, and timeline displays where the most recent items need to appear first. From my extensive expertise, the most modern and safe solution is using the ES2023 toReversed() method, which returns a new array without mutating the original. For in-place reversal, the classic reverse() method remains the fastest option.
